display_long_description:
Step into Bar Breaker, a chaotic VR destruction game set inside a neon bar made for smashing, throwing, and breaking.
Grab objects, swing a bat, use the pistol, and wreck the room piece by piece. Bottles shatter, crates break apart, tables crash, barrels explode, and the bar becomes your personal VR smash room. Every hit is built around hands-on virtual reality interaction, giving you the freedom to cause damage your own way.
Whether you want a quick stress-busting session or a simple physics playground, Bar Breaker gives you a satisfying place to smash objects without rules, cleanup, or consequences.
Features:
Immersive VR bar destruction gameplay
Breakable bottles, crates, tables, and barrels
Bat and pistol interaction
Physics-based smashing and throwing
Explosive barrel destruction
Background music and SFX volume controls
Built for Meta Quest VR play
